sloka: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि वन्दिनश्च तथापरे ।इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम् ॥२-१५-१३॥
transliteration: vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi vandinaśca tathāpare ।ikṣvākūṇāṁ yathā rājye saṁbhriyetābhiṣecanam ॥2-15-13॥

translations.english: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.
